qe: Identify the subordinate clause: “Although the road was narrow, the bus passed safely.”
qh: उपवाक्य पहचानिए: “Although the road was narrow, the bus passed safely.”
o: The road was narrow and safe
e: “Although the road was narrow” is a subordinate concessive clause introduced by “although.”
eh: “Although the road was narrow” में “although” से शुरू हुआ आश्रित concessive उपवाक्य है।
oe: The road was narrow and safe

qe: Choose the correct form: “If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.”
e: This is a third conditional: the if-clause uses past perfect, “had left,” for an unreal past condition.
eh: यह third conditional है: अतीत की अवास्तविक शर्त के लिए if-clause में past perfect “had left” आता है।

qe: What does the phrasal verb “look after” mean?
qh: Phrasal verb “look after” का अर्थ क्या है?
e: “Look after” means to take care of a person or thing.
eh: “Look after” का अर्थ किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की देखभाल करना है।

qe: Which figure of speech appears in “The wind whispered through the trees”?
qh: “The wind whispered through the trees” में कौन-सा अलंकारिक प्रयोग है?
e: The wind is given the human action “whispered,” so the line uses personification.
eh: हवा को मानवीय क्रिया “whispered” दी गई है, इसलिए यहाँ personification अर्थात मानवीकरण है।

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, “I have finished my work.”
qh: सही reported speech चुनिए: He said, “I have finished my work.”
o: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.
oh: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.
e: With a past reporting verb, present perfect usually backshifts to past perfect; the pronouns change to match the speaker.
eh: भूतकालीन reporting verb के बाद present perfect सामान्यतः past perfect बनता है; सर्वनाम वक्ता के अनुसार बदलते हैं।
oe: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.

qe: Choose the correct completion: “It is time we ___ the problem seriously.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “It is time we ___ the problem seriously.”
e: After “It is time” + subject, English commonly uses a past form to describe an action that is due now.
eh: “It is time” के बाद subject आने पर वर्तमान में अपेक्षित काम बताने के लिए सामान्यतः past form प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Which word is the relative pronoun in “The book that you lent me is useful”?
qh: “The book that you lent me is useful” में relative pronoun कौन-सा है?
e: “That” introduces the relative clause “that you lent me” and refers back to “the book.”
eh: “That” संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य “that you lent me” शुरू करता है और “the book” की ओर संकेत करता है।

qe: Choose the correct preposition: “She has been teaching here ___ 2022.”
qh: सही preposition चुनिए: “She has been teaching here ___ 2022.”
e: Use “since” with a starting point in time; use “for” with a duration.
eh: समय का आरंभ-बिंदु बताने के लिए “since” और अवधि बताने के लिए “for” का प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Which sentence is in the present perfect tense?
qh: कौन-सा वाक्य present perfect tense में है?
e: Present perfect is formed with has/have + past participle; here it is “have completed.”
eh: Present perfect का रूप has/have + past participle है; यहाँ “have completed” है।

qe: In the sentence “The old bridge was repaired last year,” what is the grammatical voice?
qh: “The old bridge was repaired last year” वाक्य में कौन-सा वाच्य है?
e: The subject “bridge” receives the action and the verb is “was repaired,” so the sentence is passive.
eh: कर्ता “bridge” पर क्रिया का प्रभाव पड़ता है और “was repaired” रूप है, इसलिए वाक्य passive voice में है।

qe: Choose the correct form: “The list of required books ___ on the desk.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “The list of required books ___ on the desk.”
e: The subject is the singular noun “list”; the phrase “of required books” does not change its number.
eh: मुख्य कर्ता एकवचन “list” है; “of required books” पदबंध से उसका वचन नहीं बदलता।

qe: Complete the sentence: “Please submit your project ___ Friday.”
qh: वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: “Please submit your project ___ Friday.”
e: “By Friday” means no later than Friday.
eh: “By Friday” का अर्थ शुक्रवार तक या उससे देर नहीं है।

qe: Choose the correct passive form: “The committee will announce the results tomorrow.”
qh: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनिए: “The committee will announce the results tomorrow.”
o: The results will be announced tomorrow.
oe: The results will be announced tomorrow.
e: In the future passive, use “will be” plus the past participle: “will be announced.”
eh: भविष्य कर्मवाच्य में “will be” के बाद past participle आता है: “will be announced.”

qe: What does the phrasal verb “put off” mean in “They put off the meeting”?
qh: “They put off the meeting” में phrasal verb “put off” का अर्थ क्या है?
e: “Put off” means to postpone something to a later time.
eh: “Put off” का अर्थ किसी काम को बाद के समय के लिए स्थगित करना है।

qe: Choose the correct word: “___ going to bring ___ notebooks over ___.”
qh: सही शब्द चुनिए: “___ going to bring ___ notebooks over ___.”
oh: वे लाने वाले हैं, अपनी, वहाँ
e: “They’re” means “they are,” “their” shows possession and “there” refers to a place.
eh: “They’re” का अर्थ “they are”, “their” स्वामित्व और “there” स्थान बताता है।

qe: Choose the correct superlative form: “This is the ___ route to the station.”
qh: सही सर्वोत्तम रूप चुनिए: “This is the ___ route to the station.”
e: “Good” has the irregular comparative “better” and superlative “best.”
eh: “Good” का अनियमित comparative “better” और superlative “best” होता है।

qe: Choose the correct conjunction: “You may borrow the atlas ___ you return it tomorrow.”
qh: सही संयोजक चुनिए: “You may borrow the atlas ___ you return it tomorrow.”
e: “Provided that” introduces a condition.
eh: “Provided that” शर्त का परिचय देता है।

qe: Which sentence uses “mustn’t” correctly?
qh: “Mustn’t” का सही प्रयोग किस वाक्य में है?
o: You mustn’t touch the wet paint.
You mustn’t to touch the wet paint.
You don’t must touch the wet paint.
You mustn’t touched the wet paint.
You mustn’t touching the wet paint.
oe: You mustn’t touch the wet paint.
You mustn’t to touch the wet paint.
You don’t must touch the wet paint.
You mustn’t touched the wet paint.
You mustn’t touching the wet paint.
oh: तुम्हें गीले रंग को नहीं छूना चाहिए।
e: A modal verb is followed by the base form: “mustn’t touch.”
eh: Modal verb के बाद मूल क्रिया आती है: “mustn’t touch.”

qe: Choose the correctly punctuated direct speech.
qh: सही विराम-चिह्न वाला प्रत्यक्ष कथन चुनिए।
oh: रीना ने कहा, हम तैयार हैं।
e: A comma introduces the quotation, and the spoken sentence ends with punctuation inside the closing quotation mark in this style.
eh: इस शैली में उद्धरण से पहले comma और उद्धरण के भीतर अंत का विराम-चिह्न आता है।

qe: In “The student who won the prize thanked her coach,” which words form the relative clause?
qh: “The student who won the prize thanked her coach” में संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य कौन-सा है?
e: “Who won the prize” modifies “student” and is the relative clause.
eh: “Who won the prize” विद्यार्थी के बारे में बताता है और संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य है।

qe: Choose the correct question tag: “You have finished the exercise, ___?”
qh: सही question tag चुनिए: “You have finished the exercise, ___?”
e: A positive statement with “have” takes a negative tag using the same auxiliary: “haven’t you?”
eh: “Have” वाले सकारात्मक कथन के साथ वही सहायक क्रिया नकारात्मक tag में आती है: “haven’t you?”

qe: Choose the correct form: “The children ___ in the courtyard when the bell rang.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “The children ___ in the courtyard when the bell rang.”
e: The ongoing past action takes past continuous; “children” is plural, so use “were playing.”
eh: जारी भूतकालीन क्रिया past continuous लेती है; “children” बहुवचन है, इसलिए “were playing” सही है।

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning to “reluctant.”
qh: “Reluctant” के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: “Reluctant” means hesitant or unwilling to do something.
eh: “Reluctant” का अर्थ कोई काम करने में हिचकिचाना या अनिच्छुक होना है।

qe: Choose the correctly spelled word.
qh: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: The correct spelling is “separate,” with “par” in the middle.
eh: सही वर्तनी “separate” है; बीच में “par” आता है।

qe: Read: “Kabir checked the weather report, packed a raincoat and left for school. The sky was cloudy, but no rain had begun.” Why did Kabir pack a raincoat?
qh: पढ़िए: “कबीर ने मौसम रिपोर्ट देखी, बरसाती रखी और स्कूल चला। आकाश बादलों से घिरा था, पर बारिश शुरू नहीं हुई थी।” कबीर ने बरसाती क्यों रखी?
o: He wanted to dry the classroom
The weather report said it was hot
He was carrying a new school bag
oe: He wanted to dry the classroom
The weather report said it was hot
He was carrying a new school bag
oh: उसे बारिश होने की संभावना लगी
वह नया स्कूल-बैग ले जा रहा था
e: Cloudy conditions and the weather report made rain seem possible, so he prepared.
eh: बादल और मौसम रिपोर्ट से बारिश की संभावना लगी, इसलिए उसने तैयारी की।
